scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the reduced model, exact phase relation, final-state equation, root uniqueness, and behavioral analysis. A later full-text final-size paper was inspected at its generalized-contact and power-law-incidence families and does not contain the prevalence-saturating strong-inhibition limit. Exact replay verifies the algebra. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The asymptotic applies to the deterministic prevalence-saturating SIR model with permanent fixed behavioral parameter and beta*S0>alpha. It does not cover subcritical initial data, time-varying behavior, or alternative low-prevalence incidence laws.

title: Strong behavioral inhibition leaves a herd-threshold final-size floor
